audience: Shopify stores that sell subscriptions with the Loop app

useCases.title: Find subscriptions and their next order
useCases.text: List subscriptions with optional filters. Open one subscription for its status, billing, delivery and next order.

useCases.title: Review upcoming and past orders
useCases.text: List the subscription orders due for billing in a date range. List the upcoming and past orders of one subscription.

useCases.title: Find a customer's subscriptions by email
useCases.text: Find the subscriptions of a customer by email address. Read one customer by Shopify customer id, with the loyalty account.

useCases.title: Read the activity log of a subscription
useCases.text: Open one subscription for its details. List its activity log, with changes and events, page by page.

useCases.title: Pause or resume a subscription, or skip its next order
useCases.text: Pause a subscription for a fixed time or until it is resumed. Resume it on its schedule. Or skip the next order of a subscription. These change billing or deliveries.
